title: Regenerative, Organic, or Conventional: A Mathematical Modeling Comparison

context_sources.name: Chen et al. 2014, soil food web complexity
Bobo et al. 2006, forest to farmland in Cameroon
Ocampo-Ariza et al. 2023, birds and bats on cacao

limitations: A watermark of repeated m characters runs through every page and through most equations.
The text contains 37 undecodable bytes, printed as replacement characters.
The carnivore equation and the aphid equation are illegible.
Figure numbers collide: two different figures are called Figure 11.
Pages 2, 3, 6, 11 and 26 carry almost no text.
The summary states a 48 percent return that the results section does not reproduce.

tasks: Model the food web of a newly converted field
Remove the herbicide and name a second beneficial species

section_map.summary: Four Holling types, 27 parameters, pests down 35 percent, yield up 25.
Four tasks on a hypothetical Italian field.
Lotka-Volterra for counts, Holling for responses.
Five compartments and a closed nutrient loop.
Phosphorus, ryegrass, wheat, aphids, then bats and sparrows.
Seven states, a rising ceiling, discounted profit.
Chemicals help and hurt. Regenerative wins after year ten.
Ladybug efficiency is the sharpest lever.
A letter to a farmer, then a request to the government.
Four sources, two on forest conversion.

contributions.summary: A food web whose functional response changes type from phase to phase.
A carrying capacity that grows with the soil instead of staying fixed.
A result that says removing pesticides makes the system worse.

dependency_graph.handoff: The five compartments and the saturating responses carry into the phased web
The tuned biological parameters feed the economic states
Differential evolution supplies the 27 parameters the phased web uses

assumptions.summary: Four species are enough to represent the web.
Chemicals switch on at day ten.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: The field is declared a hypothesis, so no site data exist.
Four baseline parameters are stated with units.

models.summary: Three phases, four Holling types, bats and sparrows added last.
Seven economic states and a discounted profit.
Differential evolution on a squared-error objective.

verification.summary: Four parameters moved by 20 percent, one at a time.
Ladybug efficiency singled out as the sharpest.

results_trace.summary: Soil fertility falls continuously across the three phases.
Regenerative value reaches about 3100 dollars a hectare by year 20.
Twenty percent more predation cuts aphids by about 35 percent.

writing_logic.summary: The textbook model is shown failing before the new one is built.
Each phase differs from the last by exactly one added mechanism.
The optimizer is justified by the failure of gradient descent.

language_observations.summary: The summary gives the menu of functional responses before any equation.
Every term of an equation gets its own sentence and its own reason.
The paper reports that removing chemicals does harm.
The letter speaks to the farmer and then to the government.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 2: a diagram of the three-part plan.
Figure 3: the senescence phase, four panels.
Figure 5: the growing phase, with bats and sparrows.
Figure 6: the system after the chemicals are removed.
Figure 7: bats and sparrows added by hand.
Figure 8: net present value over 20 years.
Figure 9: ecosystem services as a heat map.
Figure 10: a radar chart of eight sustainability metrics.
Figure 11: cost and benefit by practice, one of two figures numbered 11.
Figure 13: return distributions as violin plots.
Figures 14 and 15: efficiency and social impact.
A second Figure 11: the four sensitivity curves.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A 48 percent higher return is claimed and not shown in the results.
Accuracy is said to improve with no baseline given.
The entire study rests on a hypothetical field.

weaknesses.summary: Two of the five named phases are never modeled.
The fitted parameters are not reported.
The summary numbers do not match the result numbers.

independent_extensions.summary: Model the harvest and redecay phases that were named and dropped.
Publish the 27 fitted values and the baseline they beat.
Source the prices and the ecosystem-service payment.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Turn the most sensitive parameter into the recommendation.
State the range tested and which parameter moves the system most.

unresolved_questions.question: Where does the 48 percent return come from?
What values did the differential evolution settle on?
What happens in the harvest and redecay phases?
